market_mood.method: index_breadth counts NSE equity indices by sign of NSE's published daily change. stock_breadth counts mainboard stocks (series EQ, BE, BZ) by close vs previous close. breadth reading: 'broad advance' when 60% or more rose, 'broad decline' when 40% or fewer rose, otherwise 'mixed'. india_vix changes compare the closing level with the last trading day on or before 1 week / 1 month earlier; percentile is the share of days in the window shown on which VIX closed lower. These are descriptive statistics, not a forecast.
